description: For fixed relation domains, the truth of a second-order sentence is independent of both the individual and the relation assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.sentence_assignment_independent.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationDomains M)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.Formula L)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.IsSentence φ) (a b : ℕ → M)
  (r s : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize D a r φ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize D b s φ
